notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R6-SA103 225 x 300 (2015, 1:5), R25, white, no outer border. Symbols per the sheet's SYMBOL DETAILS (not to scale there; traced from the sign itself at 1000 dpi): skateboard 168 x 38 (28/168/29, 23 from the top; deck 8 thick, R4 ends, two 24 dia wheels at 47/75/47), 17 gap, rollerblade 129 x 90 (19/129/20 inside the skateboard's width, y 78-168; three 24 dia wheels at 21/44/44/21); 145 overall, 22 to the panel. Bottom panel: black border 3 inside a 3 white edge (sheet 3 / 6), outer black edge at y 190 (measured), R25 sign corners; SKATERS 20 E baseline 235 (190 + 45; top 215) ink 133 (46/133/46), PERMITTED 20 E baseline 275 (top 255, 25 below) ink 160 (32/160/33). Approval required.
